method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 in substance; a seat-neutral core (lsl-core.l4) with one regulative rule (applying within 6 years of the payment falling due, s 12) run by EVALTRACE inside a function that takes only plain facts; one seat layer (the worker) that restates no rule; answers are named outcomes, dates or numbers, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Long Service Leave Act 1955 No 38 (NSW), corpus document nsw_legislation:2024-07-01/act-1955-038 from the Open Australian Legal Corpus (collected 10 March 2025; unofficial, possibly out of date), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1955-038.txt. No regulation deposited: the s 3(2C) amount is an input; the Act's own board and lodging values (s 3(2)(d)) and COVID-19 period end (s 15C(3)) are used.

seat: the worker: the employee claiming long service leave or pay for it, and the personal representative of a worker who has died (lsl-seat.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run lsl-dates.l4 ; l4 run lsl-core.l4 ; l4 run lsl-seat.l4 ; l4 run lsl-cases.l4
checks.result: 131 assertions written, 131 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-08); a negative control (the s 4(11)(a1)(vii) window from 2 to 3 months, the s 12 window from 72 to 73 months, in a scratch copy) failed exactly the 7 predicted assertions
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.
